stem: On a perpendicular coordinate plane, the straight segment AB has ends A (1, 2) and B (5, 6). Plot the midpoint of AB.
solution: The ends differ in both coordinates, so find the halfway value of each separately.

hints.text: Check the order of the pair: the first number is read along the x-axis, the second along the y-axis.
Find the halfway value of the two x-coordinates, then of the two y-coordinates, separately.
